description: Advanced Persistent Threat - Stealthy threat actor (often state-sponsored) executing prolonged targeted cyber campaigns.
Denial of Service - Cyber attack attempting to render a computer system or network resource unavailable to legitimate users.
Distributed Denial of Service - DoS attack flooding a target system simultaneously using multiple botnet endpoints.
Man-in-the-Middle - Interception attack where an adversary secretly relays and alters communications between two targets.
Man-in-the-Browser - Trojan attack intercepting web browser calls to modify financial web transactions.
Remote Access Trojan - Malware offering covert administrative control and backdoor access over a host system.
Command and Control - Infrastructure used by attackers to issue remote commands to compromised host endpoints.
Client-Side Execution - Code execution occurring locally within client browsers or user applications.
Cross-Site Scripting - Vulnerability allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users.
Cross-Site Request Forgery - Web attack tricking authenticated users into submitting unwanted commands.
SQL Injection - Vulnerability allowing unauthorized database SQL queries via unsanitized application user input.
Server-Side Request Forgery - Attack forcing a vulnerable web server to issue requests to arbitrary internal resources.
Remote Code Execution - Flaw enabling execution of arbitrary commands on a remote target system.
Local File Inclusion - Vulnerability allowing attackers to force a web app to read local server system files.
Remote File Inclusion - Vulnerability allowing attackers to execute malicious code stored on a remote external server.
Open-Source Intelligence - Intelligence collected ethically from publicly accessible internet and domain sources.
Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures - Analysis framework describing threat actor behavior patterns and operational methods.
Indicator of Compromise - Forensic artifact (file hash, IP address) indicating a system breach has occurred.
Indicator of Attack - Forensics telemetry focusing on real-time activity pointing to an attack in progress.
Account Takeover - Cybercrime attack where an unauthorized party illegally gains access to a user account.
Business Email Compromise - Social engineering email scam targeting organization executives or financial teams.
Social Engineering - Psychological manipulation coercing victims to perform actions or divulge confidential information.
Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use - Software race condition vulnerability occurring between permission checking and system execution.
